guarantees.property: When `timer_enable` is low, `timer_pulse` is guaranteed low; when `timer_enable` is high, `timer_pulse` is high if and only if `prescaler_cnt` equals zero.

The threshold-hit and hash-progress signals suggest later logic may track operational progress or limits, but no security-relevant enforcement is visible here.
